{"filename": "hawaii-packing-list.docx", "content": "Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip - June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport (valid for at least 6 months)
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental confirmation (if needed)
- Emergency contact information
- Credit cards and cash
- Driver's license

Clothing:
- Swimwear (2-3 swimsuits)
- Beach cover-ups
- Light, breathable t-shirts (5-7)
- Shorts (3-4 pairs)
- Casual pants/jeans (2-3)
- Light jacket or sweater (for air conditioning)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
- Evening wear (1-2 outfits)
- Underwear and socks (7 days worth)
- Hat or cap
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins) - or rent locally
- Water shoes
- Beach umbrella or portable shade
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for electronics
- Inflatable floaties (optional)

Sun Protection:
- High SPF sunscreen (reapply frequently)
- Sunscreen lip balm
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Sun-protective clothing
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Polarized sunglasses

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots with good grip
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight rain jacket or poncho
- Trekking poles (optional)
- Small backpack for day hikes
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer

Special Activities:
- Camera with extra batteries and memory cards
- Waterproof camera for snorkeling
- Portable charger/power bank
- Travel adapter for Hawaii (same as US)
- Guidebooks or travel apps
- Cash for tips and small purchases

Health & Wellness:
- Prescription medications (in original containers)
- Over-the-counter medications (pain reliever, allergy meds, motion sickness)
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Hairbrush/comb
- Personal toiletries

Miscellaneous:
- Laundry detergent sheets (for hand washing)
- Travel iron (if needed)
- Sewing kit
- Small sewing needle and thread
- Ziploc bags (various sizes)
- Plastic bags for wet items
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Entertainment (book, e-reader, music player)
- Snacks for travel

Notes:
- Check weather forecast before packing
- Leave room in luggage for souvenirs
- Consider laundry facilities at hotel
- Keep valuables secure at all times
- Stay hydrated and protect yourself from sun"}
